evidence.detail: rs/l/B contains no instance state and only one substantive static primitive. It writes or alpha-composites one source color into one destination index of an int[] pixel buffer, preserving/combining ARGB alpha when required.

The primitive branches on rs/k/e.a(), whose class is independently recovered by R87 as GpuRenderer. When the GPU path is inactive it directly writes the supplied software pixel; when active it preserves/computes alpha and blends RGB channels against the existing destination pixel.
The only direct subclasses are the recovered rendering/image classes IndexedImage, DrawingArea, Rasterizer3D and Sprite. No non-rendering class extends rs/l/B.

Inherited calls are used repeatedly by IndexedImage and Sprite pixel-copy/draw paths, while the class contributes no geometry, clipping, image-loading or triangle state of its own. This fixes the responsibility at pixel blending rather than a broader rasterizer role.

proposals.note: PixelBlender is a conservative semantic name for the stateless shared ARGB pixel-compositing base used by the core software image/raster classes. It intentionally avoids the broader RasterizerBase label because rs/l/B itself owns only the GPU-aware pixel blend/write primitive. Confidence is 0.998.
